Talbros Automotive Components Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Talbros Automotive Components Limited filed its Q2 and H1 FY27 investor presentation with the BSE and NSE on 11th November 2026. The company reported consolidated total income of Rs. 510 crores for H1 FY27, a 19 percent year-on-year increase. Profit after tax stood at Rs. 63 crores, up 39 percent. The group secured new orders worth over Rs. 1,000 crores, to be executed over five years starting FY27. This includes Rs. 250 crores in gaskets and heat shields, Rs. 500 crores in forgings, Rs. 90 crores in chassis components, and Rs. 170 crores in rubber products. Approximately Rs. 700 crores of these orders are for exports. The company highlighted its expanding footprint in Europe and increased EV segment sales.

attchmntText: Talbros Automotive Components Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 11, 2026, titled "Press Release for Q2 & H1 FY27 Financial and Business Updatae ".
voiceSummary: Talbros Automotive Components Limited announced unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Total income from operations for Q2 FY27 reached Rs. 267 crores, representing a 23% year-on-year growth. EBITDA stood at Rs. 47 crores, up 33% year-on-year, with margins expanding to 17.6%. Profit after tax was Rs. 33 crores, a 43% increase year-on-year. For the half year, total revenue was Rs. 509.7 crores, up 19% year-on-year. Exports contributed 28% of income from operations in Q2 FY27. The company secured new orders worth over Rs. 1,000 crores for execution over the next five years.

attchmntText: Talbros Automotive Components Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Dividend  is 20-Nov-2026.
voiceSummary: Talbros Automotive Components Limited approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board declared an Interim Dividend at the rate of 15 percent, equating to Rs.0.30 per equity share of face value Rs. 2. The record date for dividend entitlement is 20 November 2026. Standalone net profit for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 was Rs. 27,77,65,000. Standalone revenue from operations for the same quarter was Rs. 26,32,08,000. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 4.50. The Board meeting occurred on 11 November 2026.
